asset.name: Credit note request
asset.description: Sent to the vendor when AP asks for a credit note to cover a match variance.
asset.subject: Credit note request: invoice {{invoice_number}} (PO {{po_number}})
asset.html_body:
Please send a credit note

Hello {{vendor_name}},

Invoice {{invoice_number}} for {{currency}} {{=FORMAT_NUMBER(invoice_total, 2)}} does not match purchase order {{po_number}} and the goods we received.

Please send a credit note for {{currency}} {{=FORMAT_NUMBER(task_data.credit_note_amount, 2)}}. The invoice is on hold until we receive it.

Note from AP: {{task_data.resolution_note}}

Sent by the accounts payable team at your company
